cardArt.title: The American Express Explorer Credit Card

product.description: Turn everyday spend into extraordinary adventures with your new travel companion.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Long term visa means 12 months or more and does not include a student visa.
eligibility.additionalValue: You are an Australian citizen or permanent resident or hold a long term visa.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Additional Cards are available for any friend or family member 16 years and over.
Applications are assessed based on the information provided and are subject to credit approval.

features.additionalInfo: Add up to 4 Cards at no additional fee.
The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
A flexible way to pay off a selected amount or portion of your Credit Card balance in equal monthly instalments. Subject to fees.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.
Up to 55 interest free days on purchases

2 points per $1 spent on all purchases, excluding government bodies.
1 point per $1 spent at government bodies in Australia.

Whether it's shopping, dining, travel or entertainment, eligible Card Members can access Amex Offers providing statement credits or bonus points. Amex Offers must be saved to the Card and used for qualifying spend, subject to offer-specific criteria, to receive a benefit.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.
Enjoy two complimentary entries per year to The Centurion® Lounge at Sydney International Airport or Melbourne International Airport.

$400 to spend on travel each year

Receive $400 to spend on eligible domestic and international flights, hotels or car hire with American Express Travel Online.

Receive up to US $100 hotel credit and room upgrade (when available) at selected hotels in The Hotel Collection when you book two consecutive nights’ stay through American Express Travel. Subject to availability and eligibility criteria.

Enjoy complimentary Hilton Honors Silver status to make every stay more rewarding. T&Cs apply. Gain status with our partner's loyalty program. Earn points and enjoy benefits at eligible hotels and resorts within the Hilton Portfolio. To enjoy these benefits, enrolment is required.

You will receive access to The Centurion Lounge® at Sydney International Airport (T1) and Melbourne International Airport (T2). Your Card grants 2 complimentary single entry passes to The Centurion Lounge® each calendar year (1 January to 31 December). You just need to show your physical Card at the front desk.
